subject: Left outer join emitting list of dataframes instead of a data frame

messages.author: ec68c9fdddcc48ab
messages.subject: Left outer join emitting list of dataframes instead of a data frame
parts:
Hi,

We are doing a left outer join and some how we are getting list of data frames instead of a single data frame as output.
When we merge the list of dataframes to a single dataframe using 'rbind', data frame was not constructed properly.
Each data frame essentially corresponds to a single row. We are unable to reproduce on small data, but it is happening in our production cluster on large dataset.
I have given code how we are using the join operation. Did we miss to handle any scenario? Sorry that I was unable provide you with the test case.
We are using RMR 3.3.

#Right Input has already keys populated
    leftMapper = function(key, values){
        output.key <- prepareKey(values)
        keyval(output.key, values)
    }

    reducer = function(key, vl, vr) {
        col3 = NA
        col4 = NA
        if (! identical(vr, NA)){
          col3 = vr$Col3
          col4 = vr$Col4
        }
        output.value <- data.frame(
            Col1         = vl$Col1,
            Col2        = vl$Col2,
            Col3    = col3,
            Col4 = col4,
            stringsAsFactors    = FALSE
        )
        keyval(NULL, output.value)
    }
    
equijoin (
        left.input  = inputPathLeft,
        right.input = inputPathRight,
        map.left    = leftMapper,
        outer       = c("left"),
        reduce      = reducer,
        output      = outputPath
    )

Thanks,
Sravan.

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: Left outer join emitting list of dataframes instead of a data frame
parts: There is a fix in master for #151. The more I think about it, the more I suspect that you have 3.2.0 installed on some node. That would explain the list output and why it happens only on big data. You could add an rmr.str(packageDescription("rmr2") in the reducer to test. Then run until you get a failure, then check the stderr of the reducers.
